Retire the stored error of a worker that is gone. Admin only; every precondition is

Make every existing PASS preflight unusable (before a rollback). Admin only, audited.

put.description:
Store the encrypted state. With ``expectedRevision`` this is an atomic compare-and-swap:
the write commits only while the stored revision still equals the revision the client read, so
a write built from an older revision can never overwrite a newer one (PLAN_STATE_VAHAN I13).
Without it (clients that predate fencing) the write is unconditional but still advances the
revision, so a fenced writer sees the interference as a conflict and re-reads.

VahanFilters.title: VahanFilters
VahanFilters.description:
Filter payload accepted from the Web UI.

Unknown fields are retained so the MVP does not need a backend release each
time VAHAN adds a filter. The Chromium worker remains the source of truth
for the selectors and supported values.
